preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 3.
The number of old cities K must be at least 2 and at most N, which is at most 100,000.
The number of newer roads M must be at least 0 and at most 100,000.
The starting city S must be a valid city number within the range of 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= X <= 10**9 and all(1 <= a_i <= N and 1 <= b_i <= N and 1 <= c_i <= 10**9 for a_i, b_i, c_i in roads)
preconditions.description: The length X of old city roads and the lengths c_i of newer roads must be positive, and all city indices a_i and b_i must be valid city numbers.

postconditions.description: The distance from the starting city S to itself must be 0.
All computed distances must be non-negative.
The output must contain exactly N distances corresponding to each city.
